notes.title: Update / Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Izanamiyako.
We have released an update with the following changes:

■ Updates

Camera Behavior Adjustment
Camera control, which was previously limited to left and right movement, can now also move vertically.

Voice Added to Title Screen
Japanese, English, and Chinese voices have been implemented.
(Please note: English and Chinese are for the title call only, not full voice-overs.)

We appreciate your continued support for Izanamiyako.

notes.title: August 22 – IzanamiYaKo – Release Confirmed!!
notes.notes: [p]This title is a stage-clear, Japanese-style escape horror action game where players must outwit pursuing spirits and find their way out of the dark labyrinth.[/p][p]With only limited vision, players must rely on sounds—such as footsteps and whispers—to sense approaching spirits and head toward the goal: the great torii gate. The controls are simple: just “Move” and “Dash.” But a single mistake could cost you your life, making every run a tense and thrilling experience.[/p][p]Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere of Japanese horror, where sound and sight merge to create a truly suspenseful escape.[/p][p]Trailer: 🔗[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsspVwtZu24&t=5s"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]#IzanamiYako #HorrorGame #Steam #IndieGame #Release[/p]

notes.title: Dev Notes2
notes.notes:
The Aberration: Megurinaku – A Lamenting Soul Wandering in Circles
"Her cries echo within an endless loop..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529338/ff868054609f81803f96ecb599f1c71ecda0cd6a.png[/img]

Megurinaku, one of the grotesque beings that appear in Izanami Yako, resembles a giant insect. She endlessly circles confined spaces with a chilling calm.
Her wide, expressionless eyes stare into nothingness—eyes that see, yet do not reflect thought or emotion. Without pause or hesitation, she traces the same path, again and again.

◆ When you meet her, it may already be too late
Megurinaku follows a fixed circular path, never directly chasing the player. But if you stray into her path, escape routes quickly vanish.
Though her movements seem simple, the surrounding structure and your own panic can turn her into an overwhelming threat.

◆ The Past of Megurinaku
It is said that Megurinaku is what remains of someone who was never able to speak their heart.
Her eyes, forever open, no longer know what they seek. Curled into herself, she continues to circle endlessly—searching for someone… or something… that she can no longer remember.

notes.title: Dev Notes
notes.notes:
The Aberration: Hasenobou – A Wanderer of the Dark Night
"Within the boundary of the underworld, they continue to walk..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529338/28d68bbe4edafaf565f52e393977a0f12d38744c.png[/img]

Hasenobou, one of the grotesque entities haunting Izanami Yako, drifts between the realms of life and death. His upper body is hidden, his legs faintly visible—an eerie silhouette barely tethered to the world. What kind of form did he have when he was still human?

◆ When you hear his footsteps, there's nowhere left to run
Hasenobou is an enemy that relentlessly chases the player. No matter how narrow the corridor or tight the gap, he will pursue you without pause. Once spotted, your only options are to flee—or hide.

Yet, Hasenobou is not a mindless pursuer. There are invisible “rules” that govern his behavior. Observing and understanding the patterns in his movement may be the key to survival.

◆ The Past of Hasenobou
Some say Hasenobou is the shadow of a being once sealed within these lands. A soul stripped of will, driven only by a forgotten mission. Long ago, he may have sacrificed himself to protect someone dear. Now, with no memory of that act, he continues to walk—bound by a vow he can no longer recall.

“Izanami Yako” has been updated to support English and Traditional Chinese subtitles!
Previously available only in Japanese, we have now added new subtitle options so more players can enjoy the game.

Voice: Japanese only
Subtitles: Japanese / English / Traditional Chinese
If you've already played, try experiencing the game again with the new subtitle options!
